(NASDAQ: RJET) today announced the successful completion of the merger between Republic Airways and Mesa Air Group, Inc. The transaction was announced on April 7, 2025 and approved by Mesa stockholders on November 17, 2025. Under the terms of the merger agreement, Republic stockholders now own approximately 88% of the combined company’s common stock and Mesa stockholders will own at least 6%, and up to 12% of the combined company’s common stock, subject to the final settlement of Mesa’s pre-closing obligations. As a combined company, Republic Airways Holdings Inc. will own the world’s largest Embraer jet fleet of 310 E-Jets supporting more than 1,300 daily departures.
